closed_findings: Template, Fixture, Envelope, SDK and Mock Lab configuration reject accessors and Proxies before any getter or trap executes.
SDK server context, capability and registered Broker arguments reject accessors and Proxies before reading or delegating them.
Catalog Schema values and direct Mock call parameters reject nested accessors and Proxies with zero execution count.

verified_assertions: Exactly three disabled read-only Connector Templates cover approval, ERP and BI categories.
Three Synthetic Tenants traverse all nine Template paths through the SDK, C16 capability and fixed Mock Lab.
Every call binds Tenant, operation, call and audience before Mock access and consumes one short-lived capability.
Template, Fixture, Envelope and runtime public input objects are bounded inert JSON and cannot execute Getter or Proxy code.
Timeout, throw, extra-field, lookup-confusion, replay and authorization-confusion cases fail closed.
No capability, endpoint, credential, real enterprise identifier, network client or external effect enters the Adapter or result.
limitations: No Target Enterprise endpoint, credential, vendor protocol, field mapping, rate limit or production Connector is present.
Capability consumption and replay tracking are single-process P1 state and do not prove cross-process production replay protection.
The timeout test proves bounded SDK waiting over a no-effect Mock, not real protocol cancellation, rollback or supplier idempotency.
This evidence does not approve G1, enter P2 or permit P3 enterprise integration.
